notApplicable.density: Realm is a transparent transport host. Feedback and remote content own spacing; the wrapper does not add a second density system.
notApplicable.hover: Remote content owns hover appearance; Realm adds none.
notApplicable.pressed: Remote content owns press behavior; retry uses the public Button contract.
notApplicable.disabled: Realm has no disabled protocol. Loading and failure expose actionable retry state.
notApplicable.selected: Selection is remote application state, not a transport-host state.
